resources.title: Top 5 BEST League Start Builds | Path of Exile: Mirage 3.28
resources.creator: Big Ducks
resources.noteEs: Big Ducks resume las 5 builds más eficientes para arrancar la liga Mirage 3.28 de PoE 1: clases recomendadas, gear paths, y por qué funcionan en early/mid/late mapping. Anchor de league-start del lado PoE 1, formato compacto.
resources.noteEn: Big Ducks summarizes the 5 most efficient builds for the PoE 1 Mirage 3.28 league start: recommended classes, gear paths, and why they work across early/mid/late mapping. League-start anchor for the PoE 1 side, compact format.

resources.title: Wolf Amazon Build Guide — Path of Exile 2: Last of the Druids
resources.creator: Big Ducks
resources.noteEs: Build deep-dive en formato largo: Wolf Amazon en PoE 2 0.4. Big Ducks cubre passive tree, gear progression, gem links y cómo escala desde campaña hasta endgame mapping. La build se basa en chain freeze para clear de mapas masivo. Útil como referencia de cómo se planifica una build full PoE 2.
resources.noteEn: Long-form build deep-dive: Wolf Amazon in PoE 2 0.4. Big Ducks covers passive tree, gear progression, gem links, and how it scales from campaign through endgame mapping. The build leans on chain freeze for massive map clear. Useful as reference for how a full PoE 2 build is planned.

resources.title: PoE 2 0.4 — Grenade Deadeye League Start Build | Doomslayer Deadeye
resources.creator: Lolcohol
resources.noteEs: Lolcohol arma Grenade Deadeye como starter alternativo para PoE 2 0.4 — la build menos meta de las primeras semanas pero con gameplay distinto al de Druid. Útil para players que quieren probar algo fuera de lo obvio en league start.
resources.noteEn: Lolcohol builds Grenade Deadeye as an alternative starter for PoE 2 0.4 — the less-meta build of the first weeks but with gameplay different from Druid. Useful for players who want to try something off the obvious path on league start.

resources.title: INEVITABLE CoC SPARK Druida Oracle — Cómodo PROGRESO de CAMPAÑA | PoE 2
resources.creator: KroximatuZ
resources.noteEs: KroximatuZ arma CoC Spark con Druida Oracle: archetype combo que aprovecha la mecánica de Cast on Critical en la nueva ascendencia. La guía pone énfasis en la fluidez del progreso de campaña — uno de los enemy points en PoE 2 — sin sacrificar viabilidad endgame. Anchor en español para builds PoE 2 0.4.
resources.noteEn: KroximatuZ builds CoC Spark with Druid Oracle: archetype combo leveraging the Cast on Critical mechanic in the new ascendancy. The guide emphasizes campaign progression smoothness — one of PoE 2's pain points — without sacrificing endgame viability. Spanish anchor for PoE 2 0.4 builds.

resources.title: PoE 3.28 — Las 5 BUILDS que recomiendo para STARTER (Liga Mirage)
resources.creator: Kyuzo Hosoi
resources.noteEs: Versión española del top 5 league starter: Kyuzo Hosoi recomienda las 5 builds más confiables para Mirage 3.28 en formato corto. Complementa al video de Big Ducks para audiencia hispanohablante que prefiere arrancar la liga sin cruzar a contenido en inglés.
resources.noteEn: Spanish version of the top 5 league starter: Kyuzo Hosoi recommends the 5 most reliable builds for Mirage 3.28 in short format. Complements Big Ducks' video for the Spanish-speaking audience that prefers to start the league without crossing into English content.
